_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment + ADR-031 declarative business logic + ADR-022 notification engine — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: kind: config — declarative booking notification trigger system. Adds two schemas: BookingNotificationTrigger (event-driven trigger config — type, channels, recipients, rate-limit, dedupe; lifecycle enabled → disabled → archived) and NotificationDelivery (immutable audit-trail record per dispatch). Reuses the BookingConfirmationTemplate / BookingReminderTemplate / BookingCancellationTemplate schemas already on dev from bookings-email-templates (ADR-037 modular layering — no template duplication). Wires booking lifecycle events from the Booking schema (bookings-resource-calendar, already on dev) onto OR's notification engine via x-openregister-notifications. No PHP listener class — trigger evaluation, recipient resolution, rate-limit / dedupe gating, opt-out checks and audit-trail recording are all declarative (x-openregister-lifecycle / x-openregister-calculations / x-openregister-notifications). A small Notification/ helper namespace exposes the pure-logic gates (rate-limit, dedupe, template rendering, recipient resolution, audit writer) for unit testing — the engine consumes the declarative spec at runtime.

BookingNotificationTrigger.title: Boekingsnotificatie-trigger
BookingNotificationTrigger.description: Configurable trigger for booking lifecycle notifications. Selects an event type (booking.created / booking.changed / booking.cancelled / booking.reminder), an ordered list of recipient rules (role + channels + optional condition), a fallback channel order, rate-limit + dedupe bounds and an opt-out gate. Dispatched through OR's notification engine (ADR-022); template selection delegates to the BookingConfirmationTemplate / BookingReminderTemplate / BookingCancellationTemplate schemas already declared by bookings-email-templates. Lifecycle: enabled → disabled → archived. No PHP listener class — trigger gating is declarative (x-openregister-notifications.appliesWhen / skipWhen).

name.description: Human-readable trigger name shown in the admin list.
name.example: Booking confirmation — customer (email primary, SMS fallback)
name.title: Name

status.description: Lifecycle state. enabled = trigger evaluates and dispatches; disabled = paused (admin disable-all toggle target); archived = retired for audit, cannot be re-enabled.
status.title: Status

triggerType.description: Which booking lifecycle event fires this trigger. booking.created on the Booking pending→confirmed transition; booking.changed on a non-status field change (startTime, organizer, attendee, location); booking.cancelled on confirmed→cancelled / pending→cancelled; booking.reminder fires on a scheduled offset (reminderHoursBeforeStart) before bookingStart.
triggerType.title: Trigger Type

reminderHoursBeforeStart.description: Only used when triggerType == booking.reminder. Hours before bookingStart to dispatch the reminder. Common values: 15 (≈15 min via /60), 1, 24. OR's notification engine schedules dispatch at bookingStart − this value (±15 min tolerance); missed windows dispatch immediately.
reminderHoursBeforeStart.title: Reminder Hours Before Start

channels.description: Channel priority order for fallback. Engine tries channel[0]; on adapter failure falls back to channel[1], etc. Each channel routes through the corresponding openconnector adapter. Recording every attempt in NotificationDelivery is mandatory.
channels.title: Channels

role.description: Recipient role. customer = the booking attendee; organizer = the resource staff member; admin_group = members of the Nextcloud 'admin' group.
role.title: Role

channels.description: Optional per-rule channel override. Falls back to the trigger-level channels when omitted.
channels.title: Channels

condition.description: Optional condition expression evaluated against the booking payload. Supports comparisons (==, !=, >, <, >=, <=) and boolean literals. Variables: booking.price, booking.status, booking.duration. Empty / true = always send.
condition.title: Condition

recipients.description: Ordered list of recipient rules. Each rule resolves at dispatch time to one or more recipients; rules with a false condition are skipped (audited as 'skipped (condition)'). At least one rule is required.
recipients.title: Recipients

rateLimitPerBookingPerHour.description: Maximum dispatches per booking per UTC calendar hour. Default 10. Excess dispatches are queued (status=queued) and visible in the admin monitor.
rateLimitPerBookingPerHour.title: Rate Limit Per Booking Per Hour

rateLimitPerOrganizerPerDay.description: Maximum dispatches per organizer per UTC calendar day. Default 100.
rateLimitPerOrganizerPerDay.title: Rate Limit Per Organizer Per Day

deduplicationWindowMinutes.description: Dedupe window in minutes. If the same (recipient, triggerType, bookingId) tuple already dispatched within this window, the second dispatch is skipped and audited as 'skipped (deduplicated)'.
deduplicationWindowMinutes.title: Deduplication Window Minutes

respectOptOut.description: When true (default), a recipient that has opted out of this trigger type (recipient.notificationOptOut[triggerType] === true) is skipped and audited as 'skipped (opt-out)'. GDPR / AVG mandates honouring opt-out for marketing-style notifications; operators can set false for strictly transactional triggers.
respectOptOut.title: Respect Opt Out

templateOverrideSlug.description: Optional per-trigger template slug override. When set, the engine fetches the named template (BookingConfirmationTemplate / BookingReminderTemplate / BookingCancellationTemplate) instead of the locale-matched default published template selected by the bookings-email-templates dispatch.
templateOverrideSlug.title: Template Override Slug

appliesToBookingSlug.description: Optional per-booking scope. When set, the trigger only fires for that single Booking slug — the modal-driven override pattern. When null, the trigger is global (applies to every Booking of the matching event type).
appliesToBookingSlug.title: Applies To Booking Slug

lastDispatchedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful dispatch from this trigger. Surfaced in the admin monitor. Stamped by the notification engine on each successful send.
lastDispatchedAt.title: Last Dispatched At

activatedAt.description: Timestamp when the trigger first transitioned to enabled. Stamped on first enable.
activatedAt.title: Activated At

enabled.label: Actief
enabled.description: Trigger evaluates lifecycle events and dispatches notifications via OR's engine.

disabled.label: Uitgeschakeld
disabled.description: Trigger paused (admin disable-all toggle or per-trigger pause). No dispatches; reactivation via enable transition.

archived.label: Gearchiveerd
archived.description: Retired. No further dispatches; audit history retained. Terminal — cannot be re-enabled.

disable.label: Trigger uitschakelen
disable.description: Pause dispatch without losing config (admin emergency off-switch target).

enable.label: Trigger inschakelen
enable.description: Resume dispatch. Stamps activatedAt on first enable.

archiveEnabled.label: Archiveren
archiveEnabled.description: Retire an active trigger. Terminal — history retained for audit.

channelCount.description: Number of channels configured for fallback. UI warns when 1 (no fallback).

isReminder.description: True when this is a time-based reminder trigger. The admin UI uses this to show / hide the reminderHoursBeforeStart field.

rateLimitSummary.description: Human-readable rate-limit summary for the admin list.

x-openregister-rbac.description: Trigger administration is restricted to the notification-administrator role (full CRUD), booking-administrator (read/update, used for the admin monitor disable-all toggle), booking-organizer (read/update — limited to triggers scoped via appliesToBookingSlug to their own bookings), and auditor (read-only). Permission slugs map onto OR CRUD permissions; enable/disable are modelled as status updates gated by the lifecycle state machine.

BookingNotificationTrigger._note: Design sketch removed from x-openregister-notifications (shillinq#1193). 'onTriggerEventFired' was never a notification rule and could never fire: its trigger was the literal placeholder '{{triggerType}}', its channels and recipients were '{{channels}}' / '{{recipients}}', and it used five keys the ADR-031 dialect has no concept of (scheduleOffsetHours, appliesWhen, scopeBy, selectTemplate, skipWhen). It described what a user-configured BookingNotificationTrigger OBJECT should contain — this schema's own instances — rather than a rule the engine dispatches for this schema. The intended behaviour it sketched: fire the object's triggerType for enabled triggers, scoped by appliesToBookingSlug (null meaning global), selecting a template by event type with a locale match and an override slug, offset by reminderHoursBeforeStart. That belongs in the service that reads these objects, not in a schema annotation. Kept here verbatim so the design is not lost: {"onTriggerEventFired":{"trigger":"{{triggerType}}","channels":"{{channels}}","scheduleOffsetHours":"{{reminderHoursBeforeStart}}","appliesWhen":{"field":"status","in":["enabled"]},"scopeBy":{"field":"appliesToBookingSlug","matchBooking":"slug","nullMeansGlobal":true},"recipients":"{{recipients}}","selectTemplate":{"byType":{"booking.created":"BookingConfirmationTemplate","booking.changed":"BookingConfirmationTemplate","booking.cancelled":"BookingCancellationTemplate","booking.reminder":"BookingReminderTemplate"},"overrideSlug":"{{templateOverrideSlug}}","matchLocale":"recipient.languagePreference"},"skipWhen":{"any":[{"recipientField":"notificationOptOut[{{triggerType}}]","equals":true,"onlyIf":"{{respectOptOut}}"},{"rateLimit":{"scope":"booking","max":"{{rateLimitPerBookingPerHour}}","windowMinutes":60}},{"rateLimit":{"scope":"organizer","max":"{{rateLimitPerOrganizerPerDay}}","windowMinutes":1440}},{"deduplicate":{"key":["recipient","triggerType","bookingId"],"windowMinutes":"{{deduplicationWindowMinutes}}"}}]},"audit":{"schema":"NotificationDelivery","writeOn":["sent","failed","skipped","queued"],"fields":{"triggerName":"{{name}}","triggerType":"{{triggerType}}","bookingId":"booking.id","channel":"channel","recipient":"recipient.address","status":"status","failureReason":"failureReason","retryCount":"retryCount","sentAt":"now"}},"fallback":{"mode":"next-channel","description":"On adapter failure, advance to the next channel in the trigger's own channels list. Each attempt is recorded in NotificationDelivery (REQ-BNT-004/005)."},"description":"Declarative trigger dispatch consumed from OR's notification engine (ADR-022, REQ-BNT-001/003/004/005/006/009). When the configured booking lifecycle event fires (booking.created / changed / cancelled / reminder), the engine evaluates appliesWhen (status=enabled), scope (appliesToBookingSlug null = global, else match), the recipient rules (each rule's condition expression), the skipWhen gates (opt-out, rate-limit per booking/organizer, dedupe), and dispatches the rendered template through the first available channel. Every attempt is recorded immutably in NotificationDelivery for audit (REQ-BNT-005). Pure-logic gating (rate-limit window, dedupe key, recipient-rule condition parsing, opt-out lookup) is implemented in Shillinq's Notification/ helper namespace for unit-test coverage; live dispatch stays in OR's engine."}}

NotificationDelivery.title: Notificatieleveringslogboek
NotificationDelivery.description: Immutable audit-trail record of a notification dispatch attempt (ADR-022). One record per (trigger, recipient, channel) attempt — fallback retries produce additional records linked by the same dispatchGroupId. Tamper-evidence is delegated to OR's audit-trail-immutable contract; the schema only declares the fields and the write-once lifecycle. Surfaces in the admin notification monitor and supports operator drill-down per booking.

triggerName.description: Name of the firing trigger (denormalised from BookingNotificationTrigger.name for audit immutability).
triggerName.title: Trigger Name

triggerType.description: Event type that fired the dispatch.
triggerType.title: Trigger Type

bookingId.description: UUID / slug of the Booking. Cross-links to the bookings-resource-calendar Booking record.
bookingId.title: Booking ID

recipient.description: Recipient address (email / E.164 phone / chat id). PII — must be masked in the admin monitor list view; only auditors with the full-read permission see the raw value.
recipient.title: Recipient

templateName.description: Template used (denormalised from BookingConfirmationTemplate / Reminder / Cancellation). Null when status=queued/skipped before template selection.
templateName.title: Template Name

status.description: Dispatch outcome. sent = adapter accepted; failed = adapter rejected after retries; skipped = blocked by opt-out / dedupe / condition; queued = rate-limit hit, queued for admin review.
status.title: Status

skipReason.description: Machine-readable reason when status=skipped or failed. Surfaced in the admin monitor for support drill-down.
skipReason.title: Skip Reason

failureReason.description: Human-readable error detail when status=failed. Adapter response message or render error; never contains raw recipient PII.
failureReason.title: Failure Reason

retryCount.description: Number of fallback / retry attempts before this record's outcome. 0 = first attempt.
retryCount.title: Retry Count

dispatchGroupId.description: UUID linking multiple NotificationDelivery records that belong to the same logical dispatch (e.g. email failure → SMS fallback). Generated by the engine on first attempt; reused across fallback channels.
dispatchGroupId.title: Dispatch Group ID

sentAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the dispatch attempt. Write-once.
sentAt.title: Sent At

queued.label: In wachtrij
queued.description: Dispatch queued for processing (rate-limit hit; awaits admin review or window reset).

skipped.label: Overgeslagen
skipped.description: Blocked by opt-out / dedupe / condition / missing address. Terminal.

markSent.label: Verzonden
markSent.description: Engine stamps on successful adapter callback.

markFailed.label: Mislukt
markFailed.description: Engine stamps on terminal failure (all retries exhausted).

markSkipped.label: Overgeslagen
markSkipped.description: Engine stamps when skipWhen gate matched.

isDelivered.description: True for successful dispatches. Drives the admin monitor 'delivered today' counter.

isPiiRecord.description: Every NotificationDelivery contains recipient PII (email / phone). Marks the record for retention-window enforcement per AVG / GDPR and for masking in non-auditor list views.

maskedRecipient.description: Masked recipient address for list-view display (e.g. 'a***@example.com', '+31***5678'). Auditors with full-read permission see the raw value.

x-openregister-audit.description: Tamper-evident hash-chained audit per ADR-022. Records are write-once; the OR engine enforces field-level immutability after the initial write. Retention 365 days (AVG / GDPR; configurable per administration). The admin monitor reads from this schema; manual edits are forbidden — operator concerns are addressed by adding a new record (e.g. compensating skip).

x-openregister-rbac.description: Read-only audit trail. No role has create / update / delete — the OR engine is the sole writer per ADR-022. The admin monitor uses these read permissions. The full-PII view (raw recipient) requires the auditor role.
